import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long capacity, flow;
        long cost;

        Edge(int u, int v, long capacity, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }

        long remaining() {
            return capacity - flow;
        }
    }

    static int totalNodes;
    static List<Integer>[] graph;
    static List<Edge> edges;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        graph[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
        graph[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static long[] dist;
    static long minCost;
    static int[] predecessor;
    static long[] capacity;
    static boolean[] inQueue;
    static long maxFlow;

    static void minCostFlow(int start, int end) {
        inQueue = new boolean[totalNodes];
        dist = new long[totalNodes];
        predecessor = new int[totalNodes];
        capacity = new long[totalNodes];

        maxFlow = 0;
        minCost = 0;

        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            Arrays.fill(predecessor, -1);
            Arrays.fill(capacity, 0);
            dist[start] = 0;
            predecessor[start] = 0;
            capacity[start] = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(start);
            inQueue[start] = true;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inQueue[u] = false;
                for (int idx : graph[u]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (e.remaining() > 0 && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + e.cost + 1e-9) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        predecessor[e.v] = idx;
                        capacity[e.v] = Math.min(capacity[u], e.remaining());
                        if (!inQueue[e.v]) {
                            q.offer(e.v);
                            inQueue[e.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (predecessor[end] < 0) break;
            long flow = capacity[end];
            maxFlow += flow;
            minCost += flow * dist[end];
            for (int v = end; v != start; v = edges.get(predecessor[v]).u) {
                edges.get(predecessor[v]).flow += flow;
                edges.get(predecessor[v] ^ 1).flow -= flow;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int maxI = 105;
        int totalNodes = 6 + maxI * n;
        graph = new ArrayList[totalNodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        edges = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            addEdge(0, x + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 105; layer++) {
                long costVal = c + d * (2 * layer + 1);
                addEdge(layer * n + x + 1, (layer + 1) * n + y + 1, 1, costVal);
                addEdge(layer * n + y + 1, (layer + 1) * n + x + 1, 1, costVal);
            }
        }

        for (int layer = 0; layer < 105; layer++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                addEdge(layer * n + j + 1, (layer + 1) * n + j + 1, 51, c);
            }
        }

        for (int layer = 0; layer < 105; layer++) {
            addEdge(layer * n + 1, 105 * n + 1, 51, 0);
        }

        int source = 0;
        int sink = 105 * n + 1;
        totalNodes = totalNodes;
        minCostFlow(source, sink);
        System.out.println(minCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
